limits: H4 baseline uses actual default catalog role place, unlike older H1/H2 role-place fixtures; do not compare absolute metrics across the studies.
Existing rewards have no role-dependent payoff. Role-kind grouping is not occupational expertise or evidence of specialized role learning.
Synthetic-only H3-audited training; public artifact contains numeric aggregates, not actor IDs or memories. Support thresholds do not provide differential privacy.
Prediction blend affects no own trials/skills/memory/matrices or personal uncertainty. No prior installation in the0007 policy store is enabled.
Same-decision MSE is measured within each candidate trajectory; cross-policy MSE levels are not a paired prediction-quality experiment.
Hourly ordinary plans, transient cold stress and own-state depth-1 opportunity cost retain H1/H2 limitations. No social/physical/P2P completion authority.
Real archive training additionally needs role-at-decision provenance and source access policy; current roles cannot be retrospectively assigned to private historical outcomes.
Validation8seeds is diagnostic, not the20seed acceptance gate; no parameters/candidate selection changed after seeing validation.
No automatic promotion, paid API, scheduler, migration, GPU training or LLM fine-tuning. Native Sites capabilities remain absent.
